content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MGU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the MGU Recruitment 2026 is 05 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Technical Assistant and Lab Assistant in Mahatma Gandhi University Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: For the Technical Assistant post, candidates must possess a B.Tech in Food Processing or an M.Sc. in Food Science and Quality Control or Food and Nutrition.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the MGU recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Technical Assistant and Lab Assistant posts is 36 years as of 01.01.2026. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Lab Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Lab Assistant position will receive a monthly salary of ₹15,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications for the MGU Recruitment 2026 must be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for MGU Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application submission via email, followed by a contractual appointment for one year.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The jobs are located at Mahatma Gandhi University in Kottayam, Kerala.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from other states apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any state-wise restrictions, so candidates from other states may be eligible if they meet the other criteria. However, it's best to check the official notification for any specific requirements.
